description: Original eligibility keeps a written blocker whose content uses a finite recursive proof (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate) T Y
%conditions ¬matches(without-elision($x), rival)
%rule candidate X [+T="other"]
%rule rival X [+T r⊇~recursive]
%rule r r [+U] <~recursive> | Y <∅>
